description: A reviewable JSON-file example with a direct semantic update command.

evidence.excerpt: The open JSON document contains an items array with stable id, label, and editable value fields.
The reviewed direct command updates exactly one identified item and prints the resulting JSON state.

requirements: Read the checked-in JSON state without escaping the approved root.
Expose stable item elements and one typed set_item_value operation.
known_limitations: This example demonstrates a JSON open-file path; non-JSON open formats require a reviewed converter bridge.
